Name: Shardust's Pastel Interiors - kitchen - crib - cellar - shed - cabin
Author: Shardust
Description:
[size=4][center][b][size=5]Retextured, pastel-colored interiors for the farmhouse(s), cabin, cellar, shed.
Featuring eight (8) color options and three to five (3 to 5) texture options to mix and match.[/size][/b]

The interiors that can be customized are the Farmhouse, the Cellar, the Shed, [size=4]the Cabin(s) [/size] and the Island Farmhouse.
[b]The Cellar[/b] is not compatible with custom cellar maps, so it's an [u][i]optional file[/i][/u].
[b]The Cabin[/b] it's an [i][u]optional file[/u][/i] as well, [size=4]to have less clutter for single player users[/size].

The colors available are called [b][color=#dbb0a7]HAZEL[/color], [color=#ffe599]HONEY[/color], [color=#b4a7d6]LILAC[/color], [color=#ea9999]MELON[/color], [color=#d9ead3]MINT[/color], [color=#dd7e6b]PEACH[/color], [color=#c9daf8]SALT[/color], [color=#fce5cd]SUGAR[/color].[/b]

Please refer to the image gallery (and inside the respective folders) for example screenshots and instructions.
Sample images below.

[size=2][i][b][size=3][u]All my mods will always be freely available[/u], but if you enjoyed them and wish to fuel my pizza cravings (I'm Italian, I [u]always[/u] want pizza)

Downloads.Description:
Retextured, Pastel-colored Interiors for the farmhouse, kitchen, crib, shed, Island farmhouse including accents, stairs, dividers, etc.

For the Cellar, Barn&Coop, and multiplayer Cabin options, check the optional files below.

Retextured, Pastel-colored Interior for the @Cabin Farmhouse.

Instructions via images are inside the folder.

Uploaded as optional file to not clutter the main file if you don't play multiplayer.

Retextured, Pastel-colored Interiors for the @Cellar.

Instructions via images are inside the folder.

Not compatible with custom cellar maps, that's why it's a separate, optional file.
